title: What Is the Hannibal Directive and How Many Israelis Did It Kill on October 7?
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Israeli media outlets have reported on the Israeli deaths caused by the
controversial "Hannibal Directive." But Western media outlets have ignored it.
On the third anniversary of October 7, we at **Zeteo** are not afraid to ask:
why the cover-up?

What exactly is the Hannibal Directive that allows Israeli soldiers to fire on
their own troops - and civilians, too? Where did it come from? How and why was
it used on Oct. 7, and how many Israelis were killed as a result of it?

Watch above, as I take you through the day of October 7, through reporting in
Israeli media and footage of high-ranking military members themselves
admitting that a "mass Hannibal" was activated that day.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Conveniently, in the relatively few cases where we know of Israeli soldiers
accused of killing Israeli civilians, the Israeli military investigated itself
and cleared the soldiers involved.

Legacy media outlets in the West seem to have taken a vow of silence when it
comes to the Hannibal Directive and completely ignored it in their reporting
on Israel and October 7. Meanwhile, independent media outlets in the West that
reported on the use of Hannibal were smeared as conspiracy theorists.

Well, three years on, their work has been vindicated - including, as I show in
the video above, by the former Israeli defense minister himself.

A lot of the Israeli families of those killed and abducted want an independent
investigation into what happened on Oct. 7, and I agree with them. Hamas
clearly killed hundreds of Israelis and committed crimes and abuses, which
they should answer for. The Israeli military, however, should also have to
answer for its actions on that chaotic and bloody day - and the Hannibal
Directive needs to be exposed, once and for all.

It would be nice, of course, if the mainstream media in the West gave a damn.
They don't - but we here at **Zeteo** do.
